research_question: Does the exact frozen RARS-v8 rank-16 int8 sidecar improve known-positive Recall@10 over both the byte-identical M32 IVF-PQ base and a storage-matched frozen PCA sidecar on the 803-query future_method_holdout, without refitting, threshold changes, or post-outcome method selection?
scope: one-shot within-program prospective confirmation of the already-frozen V8 algorithm; not an independent, official, or external MS MARCO test and not authorization to tune a V8.1 method

claim_boundary.why_not_independent: The role was never opened by V3-V8 and is prospective relative to V8, but all 803 queries were drawn from the historical v2 inner_train pool used by earlier RARS development.
claim_boundary.allowed_claim: the frozen V8 sidecar did or did not replicate within the historical research program on a role not used for V8 fitting or selection

data_policy.dataset: deterministic qrels-preserving 1M MS MARCO passage development corpus

confirmation_role.identity_materialization: reproduce the registered v2.1 inner partition and V3 hash split from the frozen train split, then copy only the corresponding global query vectors; no qrels, candidates, or labels

outcome_opening_order: verify exact source checkout and canonical protocol
verify V8 freeze and full-corpus sidecar hashes
build and verify the qrels-free future identity/query-vector packet
verify M32 index and all qrels-free limitation baselines
write and fsync confirmation_started.json with outcome_opened=false
only then parse qrels and compute candidates, metrics, and decisions

locked_limitation_baselines.m32_nprobe32: same byte-identical M32 index with twice the routing probes
locked_limitation_baselines.m32_nprobe64: same byte-identical M32 index with four times the routing probes

m48_rebuild_nlist512_nprobe16.purpose: same 48 code bytes per document as M32 plus a 16-byte sidecar, but rebuilding is allowed

metrics.primary_endpoint: paired known-positive Recall@10 difference: RARS-v8 minus PCA
secondary_endpoints: improved, harmed, and unchanged query counts

primary_randomization_test.alternative: RARS-v8 mean Recall@10 is greater than PCA

metrics.multiplicity: RARS-v8 versus PCA Recall@10 is the sole primary endpoint; all other comparisons and metrics are secondary or limitation analyses

optimization_anomaly_policy.observed_v8_fact: the recorded full-development surrogate loss rises from 0.07568628906025816 to 0.08769166847680343 and all five folds show the same direction
optimization_anomaly_policy.confirmation_action: do not change the frozen V8 artifact or rerun training; evaluate the artifact exactly as built
optimization_anomaly_policy.parallel_diagnostic: audit analytical gradient, finite-difference gradient, pre-update objective, post-Adam objective, post-QR objective, anchor term, gradient norm, and retrieval metrics on development data only
optimization_anomaly_policy.if_logging_only: correct documentation without changing the confirmation method
optimization_anomaly_policy.if_algorithmic_bug: retain V8 as an empirical frozen artifact; any corrected optimizer is V8.1 or later and requires a new development protocol

execution_environment_contract.determinism: candidate generation and scoring must be deterministic; timing is hardware-specific and repeated

prohibited_actions: changing rank, alpha, Top-B, basis, scales, codes, pair definitions, loss weights, optimization settings, metric definitions, or gate thresholds
fitting or choosing any method from future_method_holdout outcomes
opening qrels before confirmation_started.json is durable
reusing a non-empty output directory unless a complete packet is verified byte-for-byte
selecting among seeds, checkpoints, ranks, bit-widths, nprobe values, or M48 builds using holdout outcomes
calling the future role independent, untouched across the full program, external, or official
using secondary metrics to overturn a failed primary gate
hiding the higher-nprobe or rebuilt-M48 limitation baselines
continuing algorithm tuning after the one-shot result under this protocol
